title: Scaffolding technical acceptance protocol
typeAndPurpose: Type and purpose of the scaffolding
loadLimit: Permissible load of platforms and scaffolding structure
dateAndTimeOfPuttingScaffoldingToUse: Date and time of putting the scaffolding to use
signatureOfInspectionWithDate: Date/time and legible signature of the person performing the inspection
constructorInfoLine2: a) the scaffolding described in this protocol is complete and has been assembled in accordance with construction practices, standards, technical and operational documentation, and assembly instructions issued by the manufacturer or an individual design, and meets occupational health and safety requirements;
constructorInfoLine3: b) the assembly was carried out by authorized scaffolding fitters;
constructorInfoLine4: c) the scaffolding is fit for use.
constructorInfoLine5: <0>The Contractor</0> undertakes to carry out inspections of its technical condition during the operation of the scaffolding in accordance with applicable regulations, as well as upon the ad hoc request of the scaffolding user.
userInfoLine1: <0>The User</0> of the scaffolding (receiving) declares that:
userInfoLine2: a) takes over the scaffolding for use;
userInfoLine3: b) undertakes not to carry out any work related to moving, rebuilding or other work interfering with the structure of the used scaffolding;
userInfoLine4: c) will report to the Scaffolding Contractor the need to perform a scaffolding inspection in the event of any irregularities posing a threat to the safety of the work performed, and to secure the scaffolding against use until the Contractor performs the inspection and confirms the possibility of further use of the scaffolding.
ordererConstructor: Ordering party (confirming the execution of works)
dismantlingInfo: The scaffolding described in this protocol has been dismantled:
